description: Ministry of Labour - Industrial dispute between H. M. Upali Jayalath and Tokiyo Super Cement Company Lanka (Pvt) Ltd 2.Industrial dispute between Sri Lanka State Plantations Corporation and Ceylon Estate Staffs' Union
categorisation: This gazette content involves the publication of an arbitral award under the Industrial Disputes Act, which constitutes a legal/regulatory matter. It deals with statutory arbitration procedures, legal interpretations of employment law, and the formal publication of a legal award as required by the Act, falling squarely within legal/regulatory gazettes rather than government personnel/structure categories or other specialized types.
